criteria.text: D1 Necessity (minimal surface): every Request and default-profile Response field earns its place; no debug-only fields in standard; no enum that only renames seed-if-present-else-infer.

evidence.text: Request fields each Classed content|seed|opaque|control|output with defaults; no decorative policy seed.
Not in Request: context_hints/domain_hint/intent_seed_policy removed (v3); section_id removed (v4) — only a one-shot correlation_id shim.
standard include: status, candidates, writes, validation, learning_log_row, errors; full adds proposals/raw_validator_log/intent_resolution/field_build — debug/audit not default.
Intent rule is ordered seed→inference procedure, not a Request policy enum.

counterevidence: Three decision_mode values + pre_decision is a multi-mode control surface (not pure minimal).
criteria.reasoning: SCORE: 5. Every live Request field maps to content, seed, control, output, or opaque bookkeeping. v3 dropped situation/policy bloat; v4 drops section_id as a field. decision_mode values change who decides and whether writes occur (real control), not rename 'use seed else infer'. standard Response has no field_build/intent_resolution. Output trio are orthogonal jobs (preset / replace-set / side-log path). Meets anchor 5; hard gate 6 pass.

criteria.text: D2 Sufficiency (capability-complete): required+defaults complete capability or fail closed; every mandatory stored attribute has defined source; Response carries status/writes/errors and optional log row. Floor D2 ≥ 4; hard gate 4.

evidence.text: Minimal Request: project_root + human_feedback only.
Write fill paths: sources only required | seed | inference | ask | fail; table is hard-gate-4 inventory without adding Request fields.

Inventory covers id, lifecycle, domain folder; context statement/intent_keywords/context_keywords/scope.*; rubric title/intent_keywords/context_keywords/applicability.*/applicability_summary/dependencies.*/decision_rule.*/path/status.
Fail-closed predecided: missing/invalid pre_decision → status=error, no write; propose_only never writes; interactive defer → pending.
Validation fail-closed after rubric write; missing table attribute is construction bug — never write partial invalid JSON knowingly.
Response: status, candidates, writes, validation, learning_log_row, errors — thin-host complete.
Smoke asserts Version 4, Write fill paths, context_keywords, scope.include, applicability.include, fail-closed; section_id not first-class Request row.
Storage enforces non-empty context_keywords, scope.include/exclude, applicability.include/exclude — matches fill-path inventory.

counterevidence: Context-write validation is 'recommended' not mandatory (rubric write is required).
v3 audits disputed whether unnamed attrs blocked D2; v4 names them — residual risk is implementer quality of inference, not missing source class.
criteria.reasoning: SCORE: 5. This is the v3 red-gate fix. Hard gate 4 required every storage-mandatory attribute to have a defined source on the contract surface; v4's Write fill paths table line-items context_keywords, scope.*, applicability.*, decision_rule.*, index fields, id/lifecycle/domain with source classes. Required+defaults complete the job (minimal example) or fail closed (predecided/validation). Response carries status/writes/errors + learning_log_row. Anchor 5 met; hard gates 1, 4, 7 pass. Claimed D2=5 supported.

criteria.text: D3 Non-overlap: one job per field; aliases document winner+deprecation; multi-source precedence stated; default Response not audit echo stack.

evidence.text: section_id removed (v4); if sent without correlation_id, copy once into correlation_id then discard (compat shim, not a second field).
If include is non-null list → replaces profile defaults entirely (not merge).

Standard Response is not an audit echo stack: candidates operational; learning_log_row is session-log projection of primary decided candidate — not second decision channel; intent_resolution/field_build full-only.
Intent rule and Situation rule state ordered multi-source precedence; no parallel hint channel.
learning_log_row fields listed; No section_id field.

counterevidence: section_id still accepted as one-shot shim input (not dual first-class forever).
candidates[] and learning_log_row still share decision/status/summary-ish payload for the primary candidate (intentional thin-host projection, now role-separated in text).
criteria.reasoning: SCORE: 5. v3 held D3 at 4 for residual section_id dual surface, include×profile merge underspec, and mild candidates/log echo. v4 retires section_id as a field (shim-only winner path), states include replaces not merges, and explicitly denies audit-echo reading of standard Response while keeping learning_log_row as D2 thin-host surface. Multi-source attributes have stated precedence. Pattern #5 targets resolution/field_build on standard — those remain full-only. Mild shared payload is one job each (list vs log row), not dual decision channels. Anchor 5 met; hard gate 3 pass.

criteria.text: D4 Clarity: stranger maps fields to roles without host folklore; defaults explicit; minimal third-party Request example.

evidence.text: Request table: Required, Default, Class, Notes for every field.
Examples: Minimal; Seeded goals; Predecided merge — stranger third-party shapes.
Roles table: Callee owns field construction; Caller packs Request — no host FSM required in names.
intent_keywords vs context_keywords roles named (goals vs situation tags); Intent rule generalizes durable goals.

counterevidence: Domain folder inference 'from content topic keywords (e.g. workflow, writing)' is illustrative not exhaustive.
pre_decision object map form is one dense sentence.
criteria.reasoning: SCORE: 5. Names match role (goal vs situation, seed vs stored, control vs opaque); defaults and classes are table-explicit; minimal + seeded (+ predecided) examples present. No host-shaped required enums. Micro-underspec on domain taxonomy does not drop below excellent for a stranger mapping call I/O. Meets anchor 5.

criteria.text: D5 Consistency: modes, narrative, and persistence rules agree; no dead fields; ephemeral vs durable distinguished.

evidence.text: Mode matrix: interactive/predecided/propose_only with Decider, Writes, Fail-closed columns; predecided missing/invalid → error no write.
Opaque labels log-only; never control flow / not control enums.
Generalize to durable goals; reject sole one-off titles; only decided append/merge persist.
Removed fields ignored or shimmed as documented; Compatibility table matches narrative (section_id → correlation_id; intent_resolution needs full/include).
learning_log_path does not change Response shape; side-writes same learning_log_row if computed.

counterevidence: If both section_id and correlation_id are sent, discard of section_id is implied by 'without correlation_id' wording rather than an explicit both-set sentence (winner still clear).
criteria.reasoning: SCORE: 5. Mode matrix matches minimal-call and fail-closed claims; persistence matches seed language; generalization rule distinguishes session vs durable; no accepted-then-silently-used dual story for removed seeds. Opaque never steers control. Hard gates 5 and 8 pass. Both-set section_id wording is a micro-nit, not a contradiction that forces D5≤4.

criteria.text: D6 Layering: Request is call I/O not file schema dump; no host tokens as required API; callee owns schema.

evidence.text: Scope out of host lifecycle/tokens; Roles: callee owns field construction, writes, Response schema; caller packs Request only.
Fill-path table does not add Request fields (keeps layering: Request stays call I/O).
Coupling: never reimplement validators; never name parent skill; never issue host tokens; opaque not control; callee owns row shape.
Contract must not contain co-improvement-adapt, PERSIST_OK, learn-interrupt host tokens.

criteria.reasoning: SCORE: 5. Request remains lean call I/O; storage-mandatory attributes appear as fill-path rules with sources, not as dumped Request schema. decision_mode is interactive|predecided|propose_only — not host FSM names. Hard gate 2 pass. Anchor 5 met.

criteria.text: D7 Evolvability: version + changelog; alias winner + retirement path; additive optionals preferred.

evidence.text: Version: **4**

Version bumps + changelog on contract changes; Changelog **4** lists fill-path inventory, section_id removal, fail-closed predecided, include replaces, candidates vs learning_log_row, Response version 4.
section_id retirement executed: not a Request field; shim path; hosts expecting learning_log_row.section_id use correlation_id.
Unknown fields ignored; Compatibility for minimal v1–v3 Requests and additive seeds.

counterevidence: No request-side version handshake field (caller does not declare contract version).
criteria.reasoning: SCORE: 5. Anchor 5 wants version + changelog on field changes, alias winner + retirement path, additive optionals over silent breaks. v4 ships versioned Response, substantive changelog for this major, and actually retires section_id (the planned path from v3 audits). Ignore-unknown + Compatibility table favor additive/forward use. Missing handshake and thin v1/v2 notes are residual polish, not enough under charitable reading to hold at 4 when retirement was executed. Meets D7≥3 pass bar at excellence.
